title: MEMORA: Embodied Action Memory from Egocentric Videos for Reasoning and Planning
abstract: arXiv:2607.14252v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Embodied agents accumulate experience over time. We study how accumulated experience can be formed into persistent memory for future reasoning and action. We formulate Embodied Action Memory (EAM) as the capability to form and use memory over embodied experience, together with the persistent memory state produced by that process. We introduce MEMORA, a framework that instantiates EAM through a formation-consolidation-retrieval lifecycle and a multi-store world-memory architecture. MEMORA organizes experience into participant-specific Environment, Entity, Activity, and Inferred Knowledge stores: online editing revises memory as new evidence arrives, while offline consolidation abstracts repeated experience into reusable routines, habits, and preferences. We evaluate MEMORA with MEMORA-Bench, a 45-hour egocentric-video suite that measures both retrospective memory faithfulness and prospective memory-grounded planning. Across four

translated_title: MEMORA：源自第一人称视频的具身动作记忆，用于推理与规划
translated_abstract: 具身智能体（Embodied Agents）会随时间不断积累经验。我们研究如何将积累的经验转化为持久记忆，以支持未来的推理与行动。我们将具身动作记忆（Embodied Action Memory, EAM）定义为形成并使用具身经验记忆的能力，以及该过程所产生的持久记忆状态。我们提出了MEMORA框架，通过“形成-巩固-检索”生命周期和多存储世界记忆架构来实例化EAM。MEMORA将经验组织为针对特定参与者的环境、实体、活动和推断知识等存储库：在线编辑机制会随着新证据的到来而修订记忆，而离线巩固机制则将重复出现的经验抽象为可复用的例程、习惯和偏好。我们使用MEMORA-Bench对MEMORA进行评估，这是一个长达45小时的第一人称视频测试套件，可同时衡量回顾性的记忆忠实度与前瞻性的基于记忆的规划能力。在四个……（原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MEMORA框架，通过“形成-巩固-检索”生命周期与多存储记忆架构，将具身智能体从45小时第一人称视频中积累的经验转化为持久的具身动作记忆，并同时支持回顾性记忆忠实度评估与前瞻性记忆驱动规划。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MEMORA, a framework that transforms embodied agents' accumulated egocentric-video experience into persistent action memory via a formation-consolidation-retrieval lifecycle and a multi-store memory architecture, enabling both retrospective memory faithfulness and prospective memory-grounded planning.
